concerns.text: The plan specifies a one‑tailed Mann‑Whitney U test on the performance‑drop metric but does not state the correct alternative hypothesis. Hypothesis H2 expects DOPD to have a *smaller* drop than Uniform. Using `alternative='greater'` with DOPD as the first sample would test the opposite direction (DOPD > Uniform). This reversal makes the statistical test misaligned with the research question, potentially leading to false conclusions.
